# Reference images for the default style

Screenshots from Marcel Kargul's public posts, the source of the default visual language in [style.md](style.md). They live in the [giga-ui skill](https://github.com/aidan-neel/design/tree/0ab9bbb7d583236ddce6b05443a71e7a6fdbb646/skills/giga-ui/references), pinned to one commit, and are for style reference only. Use them only when the default style applies. For any other style, the reference is the one the spec names.

Fetch an image only when a step needs it, then look at it with your image tool: before you build a screen of the same kind, and beside your own desktop shot in the verification round. Without network access, use the descriptions here and in [style.md](style.md).
